name: Hà Nội
headline: Old streets, lake air, and layered mornings.
subheadline: A capital best read slowly on foot.
introduction: Hà Nội feels layered: old streets, lake edges, narrow cafes, late-afternoon shadows, and a rhythm that rewards walking more than rushing.
shortDescription: Old Quarter streets, lake walks, small cafes, layered history, and a dense northern city mood.
description: Old Quarter streets, lake walks, small cafes, layered history, and a dense northern city mood.
longDescription: The best frames in Hà Nội often come from ordinary transitions: crossing a street, sitting by a lake, watching a cafe open, or letting the city slowly get louder.
overview: A dense capital city for street textures, food, old architecture, lake air, and slow walking days.
weatherNote: Cooler months make long walks easier. Summer can feel heavy and humid.
travelTips: Plan by neighborhood instead of crossing the city all day.
Start early around the lakes and old streets.
Keep a flexible food list and follow the street rhythm.
notFor: Travelers who want quiet streets or beach energy.
seoTitle: Hà Nội Photo Notes | Old Streets, Lakes, and Cafes
seoDescription: A short editorial photo note from Hà Nội: Old Quarter streets, lake walks, cafes, food, layered history, and northern city light.
